historyProfile: native workflow template cloned under application RLS: order/address/item/summary/shipping. Historical external payment, refund, fulfillment and workflow ledgers excluded; not a full lifecycle history benchmark.
mix: 80% product browse, 15% active cart read/update, 5% native Admin order read; checkout measured separately

topology.routing: pair-wise alternating HTTP requests across two independent Node processes

checkout.provider: owned loopback fixture; real Stripe SDK; no external sandbox

queue.note: Stock-exhausted checkout jobs reach a bounded terminal failed state and require no further automatic retry; they are retained for inspection.

limits: Observed cloud CPU quota differs from the PRD 8-core reference server
Owned loopback payment provider timing is not vendor latency
History excludes older payment/fulfillment ledgers; deployment resource growth needs its own review
